t: You're looking at the former church of St Augustine with St Philip's in Whitechapel. It is Grade II* listed and was built in the Victorian period. It is no longer a church. It has been converted into a medical library for Barts and The London School of Medicine and Dentistry, and it is known as the Whitechapel Library. The architect was Arthur Cawston, who worked in London between the 1870s and 1890s and died in 1894. This building is the one he is best known for. He also published a 1893 plan for street improvements in London.
